mapper.sql: return_id AS returnId,request_sha256 AS requestSha256,order_id AS orderId,store_id AS storeId, terminal_id AS terminalId,refund_shift_id AS refundShiftId,warehouse_id AS warehouseId, business_date AS businessDate,settlement_kind AS settlementKind,payment_id AS paymentId, original_cash_payment_id AS originalCashPaymentId,promotion_snapshot_id AS promotionSnapshotId, promotion_snapshot_sha256 AS promotionSnapshotSha256,status,gross_amount_minor AS grossAmountMinor, recovered_discount_minor AS recoveredDiscountMinor,refundable_amount_minor AS refundableAmountMinor, promotion_event_id AS promotionEventId,payment_event_id AS paymentEventId, inventory_event_id AS inventoryEventId,requester_user_id AS requesterUserId, approver_user_id AS approverUserId,reason_code AS reasonCode,correlation_id AS correlationId, record_version AS recordVersion,updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ret_return WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND return_id=#{returnId}

SELECT return_line_id AS returnLineId,order_line_id AS orderLineId,sku_id AS skuId,unit_id AS unitId, requested_quantity AS requestedQuantity,gross_amount_minor AS grossAmountMinor, recovered_discount_minor AS recoveredDiscountMinor,refundable_amount_minor AS refundableAmountMinor, cumulative_quantity AS cumulativeQuantity,cumulative_payable_amount_minor AS cumulativePayableAmountMinor FROM ret_return_line WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND return_id=#{returnId} ORDER BY order_line_id

SELECT l.order_line_id AS orderLineId,SUM(l.requested_quantity) AS reservedQuantity FROM ret_return_line l JOIN ret_return r ON r.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND r.return_id=l.return_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.order_id=#{orderId} AND r.status<>'FAILED' GROUP BY l.order_line_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ret_outbox SET delivery_state='DELIVERED',delivered_at=#{deliveredAt} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event_id=#{eventId} AND delivery_state IN ('PENDING','DELIVERED')
